description: Harvey Water Irrigation Districts (HARWA-002) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Harvey Water. This dataset contains the boundaries of the Harvey Water Irrigation districts. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Harvey Water. Its tags are boundary, district, harvey, irrigation, water. It offers 3 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
